issue.title: [AAA | RADIUS] Inconsistent fallback behavior for RADIUS authentication

failure.body:
#### Description

If RADIUS server is configured but unreachable - auth is done based on local
If no RADIUS server is configured - auth is failed even if local password is correct
config aaa authentication fallback <enable|disable>   - doesn't affect behavior

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Configure authentication based on RADIUS
config aaa authentication login radius local
2. Configure any unreachable RADIUS server (wrong IP, RADIUS server is down - doesn't matter)
config radius add <IP>
3. Try to login to switch with switch existing admin user  => success
4. Remove RADIUS server configuration. None is configured now.
config radius delete <IP>
5. Try to login to switch with the same existing admin user => failed

#### Describe the results you received:
Two different approaches for similar issue

#### Describe the results you expected:
The same behavior for both cases
The best solution is to allow user configure it with existing CLI
config aaa authentication fallback <enable|disable|default>

resolution.title: Modify common-auth-sonic  to take care of case where no RADIUS server…
resolution.description:
…s are configured.

#### Why I did it
Fixes #14277.

Fixes the inconsistent fallback behaviour for RADIUS authentication when AAA authentication is configured as "radius, local".

#### How I did it

Modified common-auth-sonic.j2 template to make sure that when no RADIUS servers are configured (with AAA authentication login method set to radius, local), the system falls back to local authentication successfully.

#### How to verify it

1. Configure authentication based on RADIUS and local.
config aaa authentication login radius local

2. Configure an unreachable RADIUS server.
config radius add <IP>

3. Try to login to switch with existing admin user credentials. This is successful.

4. Remove RADIUS server configuration.
config radius delete <IP>

5. Try to login to switch with admin user credentials. This is successful.
